lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to set up the tabernacle on the first day of the first month.
The LORD tells Moses to wash Aaron and his sons with water and anoint them as priests.
Moses obeys, and the tabernacle goes up on the first day of the first month of the seventh year.
Moses places the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and Moses, Aaron, and his sons wash there.
A cloud covers the Tent, the LORD's glory fills the tabernacle, and by night a storm is in the cloud.
